name: the active tasks are listed as an array
description: GET /api/queue/tasks lists active tasks ordered by priority then id, which is the order a worker leases them in. An empty queue answers [] not null so a JSON client can iterate without a nil check; the seeded queue is not empty, so this asserts the first element carries the same Phorge field names the single-task read does. The list omits each task's data payload — that is only returned on lease — so this fixture does not assert data.0.data.
